_meta.description: WOPR Support Plane Knowledge Base v3.0 - Known issues, patterns, remediation, log noise filters
_meta.format: Each entry has a pattern (what the support plane detects), root_cause (why it happens), fix (automated remediation), and notes (context for AI reasoning)

service_issues.root_cause: Service crashes due to missing Python dependencies or stale PID. Gunicorn on port 5042 but Caddy proxies to 3001 (Forgejo).
service_issues.notes: nodemin.wopr.systems Caddy config points to port 3001 which is Forgejo, not nodemin. Caddy config may be stale. Service runs fine after restart.

service_issues.pattern: wopr-reactor service restart loop on Hetzner
service_issues.root_cause: Port 8600 conflict - wopr-ai-engine container already bound to 127.0.0.1:8600. Reactor service is a duplicate trying to launch the same image on the same port.
service_issues.fix: systemctl stop wopr-reactor && systemctl disable wopr-reactor
service_issues.notes: wopr-reactor and wopr-ai-engine are the same app (localhost/wopr-ai-engine:latest). The standalone container was deployed first. Service is a duplicate. Disable the service, keep the container.

service_issues.pattern: wopr-woodpecker service crash - forge not configured
service_issues.root_cause: Woodpecker CI requires a forge (git provider like Forgejo/GitHub) to be configured. Missing WOODPECKER_FORGEJO_URL and WOODPECKER_FORGEJO_CLIENT/SECRET env vars.
service_issues.notes: Needs manual configuration: requires Forgejo OAuth app created on the git server, then WOODPECKER_FORGEJO_URL, WOODPECKER_FORGEJO_CLIENT, WOODPECKER_FORGEJO_SECRET added to service file. Keep disabled until configured.

service_issues.root_cause: Flask app crashes immediately on startup. Usually missing config, database connection failure, or import error.
service_issues.notes: Check if the flask app is still in use. If the working directory or venv is missing, the service will loop forever.

service_issues.root_cause: oauth2-proxy template service for ai-wopr instance. Replaced by Authentik forward_auth in Caddy.
service_issues.notes: WOPR migrated from oauth2-proxy to Authentik forward_auth. Most oauth2-proxy instances are now redundant.

service_issues.root_cause: Control plane service unit exists but the binary or script it references is missing. Ghost systemd unit.
service_issues.notes: If the service binary doesn't exist at the ExecStart path, disable the unit. It will spam journal errors otherwise.

service_issues.root_cause: Mesh agent can't connect to mesh network (nebula not configured or peer unreachable).
service_issues.notes: If it keeps restarting, check nebula config and peer connectivity. May need nebula reload first.

container_issues.root_cause: elk-nginx was a standalone nginx container for Netdata status monitoring. Orphaned when elk stack was redeployed.
container_issues.notes: Safe to remove. elk-web container runs fine without it.

container_issues.pattern: peertube-postgres FATAL: database 'peertube' does not exist
container_issues.root_cause: PeerTube deployed with database name 'peertube_group7' but something tries to connect to 'peertube'.
container_issues.fix: docker exec peertube-postgres psql -U peertube -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE peertube OWNER peertube'
container_issues.notes: FATAL log noise from connection attempts to non-existent db. Creating it eliminates noise. Container stays healthy regardless.

container_issues.root_cause: False positive - v2 log scanner matched 'ooM' case-insensitively in authentik variable names. Fixed in v3 with word boundary regex.
container_issues.fix: No action needed - false positive. v3 uses \bOOM\b pattern.
container_issues.notes: v3 support plane uses tighter regex that won't match substrings.

container_issues.root_cause: Promtail crashes when log files rotate or disk fills up.
container_issues.notes: Auto-restartable. If it keeps crashing, check disk space and Loki endpoint.

container_issues.root_cause: PostgreSQL FATAL entries from connection auth failures. Not a crash.
container_issues.fix: No action needed - client connection rejections, not crashes.
container_issues.notes: FATAL in PostgreSQL doesn't mean database crash. v3 distinguishes PG FATAL (client rejection) from actual service crashes.

container_issues.pattern: authentik containers OOM killed / not responding
container_issues.root_cause: Authentik server process consumed too much memory and was OOM-killed by the kernel. When Authentik dies, ALL services behind its forward_auth proxy return timeouts.
container_issues.fix: Restart the full authentik stack: docker restart authentik-server-1 authentik-worker-1 authentik-outpost-1 (or podman restart on beacon hosts)
container_issues.notes: CRITICAL: Authentik is a dependency for 18+ services. The support plane v3 handles this via restart_group in the manifest and dependency chain ordering - it restarts Authentik FIRST before checking downstream services. Proactive memory monitoring restarts Authentik before it OOMs.

container_issues.root_cause: Container keeps restarting - usually config error or missing volume mount.
container_issues.fix: Check container logs: podman logs --tail 20 <container>. If config error, fix config. If volume missing, recreate.
container_issues.notes: Some monitoring containers are non-critical. If they keep restart-looping, the support plane will detect and report but won't disable them.

http_issues.root_cause: HTTP 525 is Cloudflare SSL Handshake Failed. Cloudflare SSL mode mismatch or Caddy cert renewal issue.
http_issues.fix: Check Cloudflare SSL mode is 'Full'. Verify Caddy cert: caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
http_issues.notes: Caddy uses dns cloudflare challenge for TLS. If the Cloudflare API token expires, certs won't renew.

http_issues.root_cause: App doesn't support HEAD method. Fixed in v3 with HEAD->GET fallback.
http_issues.fix: No action needed - v3 support plane falls back to GET automatically.
http_issues.notes: v3 retries with GET when HEAD returns 501 or 405.

http_issues.root_cause: DNS records for testbeacon subdomains don't exist in Cloudflare.
http_issues.fix: Either add DNS records in Cloudflare or remove Caddy site configs.
http_issues.notes: Test services that may not be actively used. Expected if DNS isn't configured.

http_issues.root_cause: DNS not resolving for these domains.
http_issues.fix: Add DNS A records in Cloudflare or remove Caddy configs if deprecated.
http_issues.notes: May be planned services not yet deployed.

http_issues.root_cause: Authentik forward_auth returns 403 for unauthenticated requests. Normal behavior.
http_issues.fix: No action needed - 403 from SSO-protected endpoints is expected.
http_issues.notes: v3 treats 403 as healthy for auth-protected endpoints.

http_issues.root_cause: Root cause is usually Authentik being down. When Authentik dies, all SSO-protected services behind forward_auth return timeouts. This is NOT 18 separate failures - it's 1 failure (Authentik) with 18 symptoms.
http_issues.fix: Restart Authentik containers first: docker restart authentik-server-1 authentik-worker-1 authentik-outpost-1. Then recheck downstream services.
http_issues.notes: v3 support plane handles this via dependency chain ordering - checks and restarts Authentik before evaluating downstream HTTP endpoints.

auth_issues.root_cause: Expression policy binding on authorization flow blocking users.
auth_issues.fix: Remove restrictive policy binding via Authentik API: DELETE /api/v3/policies/bindings/{binding_pk}/
auth_issues.notes: Common fix: remove group-check policies from apps that should be accessible to all authenticated users.

auth_issues.pattern: NULL policy bindings causing auth failures
auth_issues.root_cause: Policy bindings with policy=null (policy deleted but binding remains).
auth_issues.fix: Find and delete null bindings: GET /api/v3/policies/bindings/?page_size=200, DELETE any where policy is null.
auth_issues.notes: Run periodic cleanup of orphaned policy bindings.

auth_issues.root_cause: Synapse OIDC localpart_template generates duplicate username when manually-created account exists.
auth_issues.fix: In Synapse PostgreSQL: UPDATE user_external_ids SET user_id = '@correct_user:domain'
auth_issues.notes: Access Synapse DB: docker exec -it synapse-db psql -U synapse

infrastructure_issues.root_cause: Multiple .caddy files define the same domain.
infrastructure_issues.fix: Find duplicates: grep -rl 'domain' /etc/caddy/sites-enabled/. Rename duplicate to .bak.
infrastructure_issues.notes: Common when old .caddy file left alongside new one.

infrastructure_issues.root_cause: Caddy replace values containing HTML/quotes must use backtick quoting.
infrastructure_issues.fix: Use Python scripts to write Caddy configs. Never use heredoc or sed.
infrastructure_issues.notes: Backticks are critical for values containing quotes, angles, or special chars.

infrastructure_issues.root_cause: wopr-nav-inject snippet replaces </head> and </body>. Conflicts with site-level replace blocks.
infrastructure_issues.fix: Don't use 'import wopr-nav-inject' in sites with custom replace blocks.
infrastructure_issues.notes: Sites needing custom replace must include all injections in their own block.

infrastructure_issues.pattern: Excessive SSH auth failures from own IP
infrastructure_issues.root_cause: SSH brute force from WOPR's own IP. Misconfigured service or cron job.
infrastructure_issues.notes: Generates hundreds of journal errors per hour.

infrastructure_issues.root_cause: systemd service has WorkingDirectory pointing to missing path.
infrastructure_issues.fix: Create the missing directory or fix the WorkingDirectory path.
infrastructure_issues.notes: Generates errors every few seconds in journalctl.

theme_and_branding.pattern: Element Call / Element Web not CRT themed
theme_and_branding.root_cause: Caddy replace directive not injecting CRT CSS.
theme_and_branding.fix: Ensure Caddy config has replace block injecting CSS before </head>

theme_and_branding.pattern: Washed out buttons on CRT theme
theme_and_branding.fix: Use dark background with green border: background: #0d0d0d; color: #00ff41; border: 2px solid #00ff41;
theme_and_branding.notes: WOPR CRT theme palette: primary green #00ff41, backgrounds #0a0a0a/#0d0d0d

theme_and_branding.pattern: Missing WOPR nav bar / AI button
theme_and_branding.root_cause: wopr-global-nav-v6.4.js not injected via Caddy replace.
theme_and_branding.notes: Global nav JS served from WOPR prod. Host-aware.

theme_and_branding.pattern: SSO shows 'Authentik SSO' instead of 'WOPR SSO'
theme_and_branding.root_cause: Synapse homeserver.yaml has idp_name set to 'Authentik SSO'.
theme_and_branding.fix: Change idp_name to 'WOPR SSO' in homeserver.yaml, then docker restart synapse

support_plane_self_issues.fix: Pull model: ollama pull phi3:mini. Or ignore - AI analysis is optional.
support_plane_self_issues.notes: v3 caches Ollama availability check and only logs once instead of every scan.

support_plane_self_issues.pattern: Email alerts fail with connection refused
support_plane_self_issues.notes: Email alerts are non-fatal. Issues still logged.

support_plane_self_issues.pattern: False positive OOM detection in container logs
support_plane_self_issues.root_cause: Regex too broad - catches substrings and PG client rejections.
support_plane_self_issues.fix: Fixed in v3 - uses \bOOM\b word boundary and excludes PG FATAL client rejections.
support_plane_self_issues.notes: v3 distinguishes PostgreSQL FATAL (normal client rejection) from actual service crashes.

support_plane_self_issues.pattern: HTTP endpoint check returns 501/405 for HEAD
support_plane_self_issues.root_cause: Some apps don't implement HEAD method.
support_plane_self_issues.fix: Fixed in v3 - automatically falls back to GET when HEAD returns 501/405.
support_plane_self_issues.notes: matrix-request.wopr.systems was the primary trigger for this.

support_plane_self_issues.pattern: Support plane counts SSH brute force as WOPR errors
support_plane_self_issues.root_cause: v2 log scanner counted all lines matching 'error' in journalctl including SSH auth failures from random IPs.
support_plane_self_issues.fix: Fixed in v3 - log noise filter excludes sshd auth failures, ntfy stats, and other known noise patterns.
support_plane_self_issues.notes: v3 filters out SSH brute force, ntfy stats lines, and other noise before counting errors. Only genuine WOPR service errors are counted.

log_noise_issues.pattern: SSH brute force attempts in journalctl
log_noise_issues.root_cause: Random IPs trying SSH password auth. Normal internet noise on any public server.
log_noise_issues.fix: No action needed - filtered out by v3 support plane.
log_noise_issues.notes: Patterns filtered: Failed password, Invalid user, authentication failure, kex_protocol_error. These are NOT WOPR errors.

log_noise_issues.pattern: ntfy Server stats lines containing 'failure' fields
log_noise_issues.root_cause: ntfy logs stats every 60s with fields like emails_received_failure=0. The word 'failure' in field names triggers error detection.
log_noise_issues.fix: No action needed - filtered out by v3 support plane.
log_noise_issues.notes: These are INFO-level stats, not errors. The 'failure' is a field name showing count=0.

log_noise_issues.pattern: systemd session open/close for SSH connections
log_noise_issues.root_cause: Normal systemd session management for SSH connections. Not errors.
log_noise_issues.fix: No action needed - filtered out by v3 support plane.
log_noise_issues.notes: Lines like 'Session 43789 logged out', 'Removed session', 'session-XXXX.scope' are normal.
